summary.text: Janice Rich, a Republican, has represented District 7 in the Colorado State Senate since January 2023, after serving in the Colorado House of Representatives (District 55) from 2019 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, she advanced from the June 30, 2026 Republican primary and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for re-election.
Rich previously served as the Mesa County Treasurer and the Mesa County Clerk & Recorder.

Her career experience also includes owning and operating a secretarial and business support service and working as a legal assistant and court clerk in the U.S. Magistrate's office in western Colorado.
